NER.note: Only a 2023 arrete on e-signature in procurement, no service stated.

facts.fact: The tribune says SIGMAP-Niger, launched in 2016 and in a 2.0 version since 2022, is the operational platform where public buyers publish tenders and award notices.
The tribune says each public buyer enters its procurement plan, tender and award notices and disputes in SIGMAP, whose use an arrete of 27 March 2017 made mandatory.

NER.note: Only a procurement arrete on dematerialisation, not an e-commerce law.
